name: St Thomas of Canterbury, Higher Broughton

boundary.description: From the junction of Bury Old Road and Singleton Road, E along Bury Old Road, Waterloo Road, Broughton Lane, Great Clowes Street and the Priory to its junction with Lower Broughton Road. Then by a beeline W to the River Irwell, and N along the river to the point opposite the junction of Bury New Road and Broom Lane. N along Bury New Road, Park Lane and Singleton Road to its junction with Bury Old Road.
